_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: J. E. Crawford Flitch (1881-1946): Unamuno's The Tragic Sense of Life (1921) and Essays and Soliloquies (1925). Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 31); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

flitch-unamuno-tragic-sense-of-life.note: The Gutenberg text was keyed from the 1954 Dover reprint, which states it is 'an unabridged and unaltered republication of the English translation originally published by Macmillan ... in 1921'. The text is the 1921 public-domain translation, but the copy is not a pre-1931 printing: flagged in DIGEST-C for Adam's veto.

_name_words_note: Translator name only: fetch_shelf.py treats it as the identity check, so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
